import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def precompute_combinations(n, m):
    # Precompute nCk for all necessary values
    comb = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(n + 1):
        comb[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, min(i, m) + 1):
            comb[i][j] = (comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]) % MOD
    return comb

def solve(n, m):
    comb = precompute_combinations(n + m - 1, m)
    
    result = 0
    for k in range(1, n + 1):
        ways_a = comb[k + m - 1][m]
        ways_b = comb[n - k + m][m]
        result = (result + ways_a * ways_b % MOD) % MOD
    
    return result

def main():
    data = input().strip()
    n, m = map(int, data.split())
    result = solve(n, m)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
